statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Diagnosis codes I25.10 and I34.0 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The denial reason is that the service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
The cardiac event monitoring study is medically necessary
The study is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias associated with the documented symptoms
